# ---- driver: gen3_reads_dump_emerald.lua ----
-- E2-CKPT scratch driver: reads == PYDEC on BPEE. Loads SLINK_STATE, builds lua/gen3/reads.lua on
-- the Emerald profile + pack pointers (the checkpoint probe's own construction), and writes
-- raw bytes (DUMP) and reads.lua's decodes (LUA / LUAX) to SLINK_READS_DUMP. Read-only.
local WT = SLINK_ROOT or os.getenv("SLINK_ROOT")
local G = dofile(WT .. "/lua/tests/gen3_boot_check.lua")
local JSON = dofile(WT .. "/lua/json_codec.lua")
G.open("gen3_reads_dump_emerald")
local cp = G.checkpoint()
memory.usememorydomain("System Bus")
local ok = savestate.load(os.getenv("SLINK_STATE"))
if ok ~= true then G.finish(false, "savestate.load refused") end
G.idle(30)
local f = assert(io.open(WT .. "/data/games/gen3_emerald/profile.json", "rb"))
local profile = JSON.decode(f:read("a")).titles.emerald
f:close()
local function bytes(a, n)
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, n do out[i] = memory.read_u8(a + i - 1) end
    return out
end
local io_ro = {
    read_u8 = function(a) return memory.read_u8(a) end,
    read_u16 = function(a) return memory.read_u16_le(a) end,
    read_u32 = function(a) return memory.read_u32_le(a) end,
    read_bytes = bytes,
}
local reads = dofile(os.getenv("SLINK_READS_LUA") or (WT .. "/lua/gen3/reads.lua")).new(profile, io_ro, cp.pointers)
local d = profile.derived
local out = assert(io.open(os.getenv("SLINK_READS_DUMP"), "w"))
local function hex(b)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, #b do t[i] = string.format("%02x", b[i]) end
    return table.concat(t)
end
local function dump(name, a, b)
    out:write(string.format("DUMP name=%s addr=0x%X len=%d frame=%d hex=%s\n", name, a, #b, emu.framecount(), hex(b)))
end
local function mon_line(name, mon)
    out:write(string.format("LUA name=%s slot=%d key=%s species=%s level=%s hp=%s nickname=%s\n",
        name, mon.slot, reads.key(mon), tostring(mon.species), tostring(mon.level or ""),
        tostring(mon.hp or ""), mon.nickname))
end
local count = memory.read_u8(profile.ram.PARTY_COUNT_ADDR)
local pb = assert(reads.party_base())
dump("party", pb, bytes(pb, count * 100))
for _, m in ipairs(assert(reads.read_party())) do mon_line("party", m) end
local st = assert(reads.read_storage())
dump("box0", st + d.BOX_DATA_OFFSET, bytes(st + d.BOX_DATA_OFFSET, 30 * 80))
for _, m in ipairs(assert(reads.read_box(0))) do mon_line("box0", m) end
-- extras: separate prefix so the party/box parser never sees them
local sb1, sb2 = assert(reads.read_sb1()), assert(reads.read_sb2())
out:write(string.format("XDUMP name=sb2 addr=0x%X hex=%s\n", sb2, hex(bytes(sb2, 0xB0))))
out:write(string.format("XDUMP name=sb1 addr=0x%X hex=%s\n", sb1, hex(bytes(sb1, 8))))
out:write(string.format("XDUMP name=flags addr=0x%X hex=%s\n", sb1 + d.SB1_FLAGS_OFFSET,
    hex(bytes(sb1 + d.SB1_FLAGS_OFFSET, 0x120))))
out:write(string.format("XDUMP name=balls addr=0x%X hex=%s\n", sb1 + d.SB1_BALL_POCKET_OFFSET,
    hex(bytes(sb1 + d.SB1_BALL_POCKET_OFFSET, 4 * d.SB1_BALL_POCKET_COUNT))))
local function x(name, fn)
    local ok, a, b = pcall(fn)
    if not ok or a == nil then out:write("LUAX " .. name .. " error=" .. tostring(ok and b or a) .. "\n")
    else out:write("LUAX " .. name .. " " .. a .. "\n") end
    out:flush()
end
x("trainer", function() local t, w = reads.read_trainer(); if not t then return nil, w end
    return string.format("ot_id=%d name=%s", t.ot_id, t.name) end)
x("location", function() local l, w = reads.read_location(); if not l then return nil, w end
    return string.format("map_group=%d map_num=%d", l.map_group, l.map_num) end)
x("badges", function() local v, w = reads.read_badges(); if v == nil then return nil, w end
    return string.format("value=%d", v) end)
x("balls", function() local b, w = reads.read_balls(); if not b then return nil, w end
    return string.format("ball_count=%d has_pokeballs=%s", b.ball_count, tostring(b.has_pokeballs)) end)
out:close()
G.finish(true, "party=" .. count .. " dumped")

# ---- comparison: run_reads_pydec.py ----
"""E2-CKPT scratch: reads == PYDEC on BPEE. Runs gen3_reads_dump_emerald.lua on a savestate, then
diffs reads.lua's decodes against tools/gen3_reads_pydec.py's independent decoders (gen3_codec)."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

WT = 'E:/Google Drive/SLink/.claude/worktrees/gen3-emerald'
os.chdir(WT)
os.environ.setdefault('SLINK_GEN3_FIXTURE_RUNS', 'C:/slink-wt/emerald-e2')
sys.path.insert(0, WT + '/tools')
import gen3_fixtures as fx  # noqa: E402
import gen3_reads_pydec as pd  # noqa: E402

state = sys.argv[1]
dump = 'C:/slink-wt/emerald-e2/reads_dump_emerald.txt'
if '--no-run' not in sys.argv:
    rom = fx.resolve_rom('emerald', None)
    seed = fx.codec.split_rtc(open(WT + '/tests/fixtures/gen3/emerald_town.sav', 'rb').read())[0]
    rom_rel, run_dir, _ = fx._prepare_run('reads_pydec_emerald', rom, seed=seed,
                                          saveram_name_override=fx.EMERALD_SAVERAM)
    ok, text = fx._launch('C:/slink-wt/emerald-e2/gen3_reads_dump_emerald.lua', rom_rel, run_dir, rr=False,
                          timeout=300, title='emerald',
                          extra_env={'SLINK_GEN3_CHECKPOINT': WT + '/data/games/gen3_emerald/write_checkpoint.json',
                                     'SLINK_STATE': state, 'SLINK_READS_DUMP': dump,
                                     **({'SLINK_READS_LUA': sys.argv[2]} if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2].endswith('.lua') else {})})
    print(text.rstrip())
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)

derived = json.load(open(WT + '/data/games/gen3_emerald/profile.json'))['titles']['emerald']['derived']
dumps, lua_lines = pd.parse_dump(__import__('pathlib').Path(dump))
diffs = pd.diff_dump(dumps, lua_lines, False)
print(f"## party/box: {len(diffs)} difference(s) over {sum(len(v) for v in lua_lines.values())} LUA mon line(s)")
for row in diffs:
    print("DIFF", row)
mut = pd.apply_mutation(dumps)
mdiffs = pd.diff_dump(dumps, lua_lines, False)
print(f"## planted-offender control: flipped byte 0 of the first {mut} record -> {len(mdiffs)} difference(s)")

x, lx = {}, {}
for ln in open(dump, encoding='utf-8'):
    p = ln.split()
    if p[0] == 'XDUMP':
        x[p[1][5:]] = bytes.fromhex(p[3][4:])
    elif p[0] == 'LUAX':
        lx[p[1]] = {'error': ln.split('error=', 1)[1].strip()} if 'error=' in ln else dict(kv.split('=', 1) for kv in p[2:])
sb2, sb1, flags, balls = x['sb2'], x['sb1'], x['flags'], x['balls']
py = {
    'trainer': pd.decode_trainer(sb2, derived['SB2_OT_ID_OFFSET'], derived['SB2_NAME_OFFSET']),
    'location': pd.decode_location(sb1, derived['SB1_LOCATION_MAP_GROUP_OFFSET'], derived['SB1_LOCATION_MAP_NUM_OFFSET']),
    'badges': {'value': pd.decode_badges_for_profile(flags, derived)[0]},
    'balls': pd.decode_ball_pocket(balls, derived['SB1_BALL_POCKET_COUNT'],
                                   int.from_bytes(sb2[derived['SB2_ENC_KEY_OFFSET']:derived['SB2_ENC_KEY_OFFSET'] + 4], 'little')),
}
bad = 0
for k, fields in py.items():
    for f, v in fields.items():
        lua_v = lx[k].get(f, 'ERROR ' + lx[k].get('error', '?'))
        same = str(v).lower() == lua_v.lower() if isinstance(v, bool) else str(v) == lua_v
        bad += not same
        print(f"{'OK  ' if same else 'DIFF'} {k}.{f} lua={lua_v} py={v}")
enc = int.from_bytes(sb2[0xAC:0xB0], 'little')
print(f"# encryptionKey low16=0x{enc & 0xFFFF:04X} (raw ball qty words XOR it)")
print("RESULT:", "PASS" if not diffs and mdiffs and not bad else "FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if not diffs and mdiffs and not bad else 1)
